subject: maths
title: Volume Voyage
description: Spin curves about the x-axis and compute volumes of revolution.

concepts.def: Rotating y=f(x) around the x-axis from a to b: V = π∫ₐᵇ y² dx.
Each thin slice is a disc of area πy² and thickness dx.
Square y first, then integrate term by term.
Use the correct x-bounds where the curve is rotated.
Rotating about y-axis: V = π∫ x² dy (rearrange first).
Volume units are cube units, e.g. cubic metres.

walkthroughs.h2: Volume from y=x between 0 and 2 about x-axis
walkthroughs.body_html:
y² = x²

V = π∫₀² x² dx = π[x³/3]₀² = 8π/3

walkthroughs.h2: Volume from y=√x between 0 and 4 about x-axis
walkthroughs.body_html:
y² = x

V = π∫₀⁴ x dx = π[x²/2]₀⁴ = 8π
